platform.evidenceNotice: Seven existing API37 phone captures include dark home at font scale 1.3 and a disconnected, explicitly synthetic profile. They predate the latest PTZ cleanup and two validation-copy spacing corrections. Active live controls and later AP setup phases are source-reviewed only; these captures do not prove camera interoperability. No new captures or connection tests were performed for this documentation pass.

narrative.overview:
The confirmed direction uses Android platform conventions, Indonesian copy, a compact camera list and one foreground player. Clear status, readable controls and familiar form behavior define the interface.

This record describes the current Android interface in `app/src/main/java/dev/cctv/v380/ui`, including the experimental debug player, AP setup and diagnostics. It preserves the user-approved Material direction; it does not certify camera connectivity. Tokens use Android `dp` and `sp`; component heights are minimums where the source uses `heightIn`.
keyCharacteristics: Native Compose Material 3 components and system typography.
System-selected light and dark themes with green primary accents.
Scrollable phone layouts, explicit connection status and controls gated by streaming state and camera capabilities.

rules.name: The Inherited Roles Rule
rules.body: Overriding primary does not regenerate the Material palette. `onPrimary`, `primaryContainer`, `onPrimaryContainer` and error roles retain library defaults; the visible FAB and camera-row icon container can therefore be purple. Do not describe the current build as a complete green tonal palette.

rules.name: The Platform Type Rule
rules.body: Keep text in Material roles and allow wrapping and system scaling instead of fixing text containers to a single line height.

dos: **Do** use native Material components, system font scaling and the system-selected theme.
**Do** preserve Indonesian labels, explicit connection status and state/capability gating for unavailable controls.
**Do** use the shared spacing rhythm and minimum interactive target sizing.
donts: **Don't** infer a regenerated green palette from the customized primary color.
**Don't** use invented footage, decorative imagery or dashboard metrics in this camera interface.
**Don't** present synthetic tests, a selected quality chip or the black player surface as proof of camera interoperability.
